segments.oily: Reviewers who describe their skin as oily consistently report the lotion hydrates without adding shine or extra oiliness, including some who say it helped balance visibly oily or shiny skin.
segments.dry: Most reviewers with dry skin, including some with seborrheic dermatitis or chronic flaking, report the lotion resolved persistent dryness and tightness, though one reviewer with normal-dry skin found the Amazon-bought version too heavy for her face.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report the lotion balances their skin, with one describing her dry/combination skin becoming more 'normal' after regular use.
segments.sensitive: The large majority of self-described sensitive-skin reviewers, including several with rosacea or seborrheic dermatitis, report no irritation or breakouts, but one reviewer with sensitive/acne-prone skin developed breakouts along her jawline after several weeks of use and warns others to avoid it.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to 60s generally report smoother texture and a healthier-looking complexion with regular use, though the improvements described are moderate rather than dramatic.

concerns.aging: Reviewers who mention aging report smoother texture, softened fine lines, and a fresher-looking complexion after weeks of regular use, including one reviewer in her early 40s who noticed less visible wrinkling.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin, including some with chronic flaking or tightness, widely report lasting hydration and relief; one reviewer notes it may not be rich enough for very dry skin.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers with rosacea, seborrheic dermatitis, or general redness/irritation from other products report a calming effect and reduced redness over time, with one describing it as the only product that has kept her rosacea and redness under control for years.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers who mention barrier concerns, including damaged or over-treated skin, report the lotion helps restore comfort and moisture levels without irritation.
concerns.spots: A small number of reviewers report improvement in pigmentation or uneven skin tone after several weeks of use, though this is a minor theme compared to hydration.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several with acne-prone or hormonal breakouts, report fewer blemishes and no new breakouts, but one reviewer describes developing breakouts along her jaw and chin after weeks of use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin consistently report the lotion hydrates without increasing shine or oiliness, helping balance skin that previously felt greasy.

extraits.titre: IF YOU HAVE SENSITIVE/ACNE-PRONE SKIN, RUN FOR YOUR LIFE!
extraits.texte: IF YOU HAVE SENSITIVE/ACNE-PRONE SKIN, RUN FOR YOUR LIFE! I spent a large chunk of my life mistreating my skin, using harsh products, never moisturizing, never taking my makeup off at night -- a whole host of skincare sins. In my early 20s (26 now) I figured out that my skin doesn't play well with most products and that it's actually not acne-prone pretty much at all if I use gentle products designed for sensitive skin (face wash, moisturizer, toner, etc) and don't over-dry it with harsh products; I can wear any makeup I want, pretty much, too, and my skin is fine as long as I wash it off well at night. I read so many reviews that said such great things about CeraVe (all pertaining the the niacinamide that it contains that actually IS good for your skin) and thought it'd be great at lightening out red marks I have from the years of mistreating my skin (mind you, these red marks were hardly visible at the time I bought CeraVe; I just wanted to perfectly even my skin tone and maybe reduce some pores). I WISH I HAD NEVER HEARD OF THIS PRODUCT. Previously, I wrote a great review for this product, because parts of my face WERE looking softer and luminous (turns out this was Paula's Choice's AHA doing this, which I've been using for a couple of weeks now and LOVE and will never stop using). At the time, I thought it was the niacinamide, and I thought that the breakouts popping up on my chin/jaw line were the AHA's fault (or my period or stress or something). So I KEPT USING CERAVE.

Please refer to my photo. The product on the left I bought here on Amazon. The product on the right I bought in Mexico. That was my first time purchasing it and when I came to the United States, I wanted to try it again so I bought the one on the left from Amazon. The one on the left is heavy. it is nothing like the one on the right which is light and lovely and the reason I bought it for a second time. Mind you I purchased the one in Mexico at a higher end pharmacy and this one that I bought from Amazon had to go through extra shipping and also the packaging is different. I don’t know if it was just a one off, but I will only be using this on my body. It is definitely not light. You can “feel” the product sitting on top of your skin. It is definitely not something I want to put on my face. I tried it two days in a row and today I ended up washing it off and putting on my usual higher-end expensive lotion that I was looking for a cheaper alternative to. I guess I have to keep looking. I know that a lot of people love this, but for people truly truly looking for a light face lotion? I’m not sure if this is the one. I would name the one that I normally use, but I don’t think that is allowed here. I will just put this on my chest. It’s too heavy for the face. My skin is normal-dry.

extraits.titre: My new holy grail (biracial with brown skin)
extraits.texte: I absolutely love this product! I only recently "discovered" CeraVe and this is my favorite and also possibly my all-time favorite facial product. I've always had oily, congested skin, prone to breakouts, and I have a bit of uneven skin tone. I've tried all kinds of products to get rid of acne/blackheads/scars and I guess never realized how important my night moisturizer was. This stuff is so light but it really is very moisturizing. My skin finally has everything it needs to repair and protect itself without being weighed down. My skin is so clear since I've been using this, so soft and I can tell after just 5 or 6 weeks that my uneven skin tone is evening out. I'm very happy with it. I'm mixed, half black half white, with medium brown skin. I use Aveeno clear complexion daily moisturizer in the mornings, if I'll be out I use the CeraVe ultra-light moisturizer with spf 30. At night I use just a charcoal soap I got from a local farmers market, Burt's bees eye cream, and this moisturizer. I don't really wear makeup, sometimes I'll wear blush and mascara but my face is usually bare.

extraits.titre: Excellent moisturizer, life-changing for my skin
extraits.texte: This cream has helped me so much with my dry skin. A couple of years ago, I had a hydrofacial that caused redness on my chin. I thought it was just part of the deep cleansing process, but the redness didn’t go away—in fact, it got worse. Later, I also developed red spots and small bumps on my forehead between my eyebrows. I became very worried and went to a dermatologist. At first, I thought it might be an allergy or dermatitis, but the doctor diagnosed me with rosacea. He prescribed a special cream from the pharmacy for a week and also recommended that I use CeraVe cream every day to keep my skin hydrated. Since then, I’ve been using it, and my skin no longer looks or feels dry. I only use the night cream, and it works wonderfully for me. My skin has improved so much, and I’m very happy with the results. Highly recommend!
